fields.title: Okwemanyiiza Okubeerawo kwa Katonda
fields.subtitle: Etteeka Erisinga mu Bulamu Obutukuvu
fields.description: Brother Lawrence yali ow’oluganda omumonaki atali kabona mu Bakarumeli Abatambula Ebigere Obwereere e Paris. Yali muserikale edda, n’oluvannyuma omuweereza w’omu nnyumba, n’amala emyaka kkumi na etaano ng’afumbira ennyumba y’abamonaki mu ffumbiro lye yagamba nti lyali limukyayisa nnyo mu butonde bwe. Kye yayigira eyo kwe kubeera buli ssaawa wamu ne Katonda — “mu kuyoogaana n’okukubagana kw’ebintu mu ffumbiro lyange,” nga bwe yakyogera, mu mirembe nga gye yandibadde nagyo ng’afukamidde mu maaso ga Ssakramentu. Wano waliwo emboozi ennya Joseph de Beaufort ze yawandiika ng’ayogera naye mu 1666 ne 1667, n’ebbaluwa ze kkumi na ttaano, ezisinga obungi ze yawandiika mu bukadde bwe eri mikwano gye abaali abalwadde oba abaali mu buzibu: akatabo akatono, akatali ka basomi, akangu, Abakatoliki n’Abaprotestanti ke baagala kyenkanyi okumala ebyasa bisatu.

qa.question: Brother Lawrence yali ani?
qa.answer: Brother Lawrence ow’Okuzuukira yali ow’oluganda omumonaki atali kabona mu Bakarumeli Abatambula Ebigere Obwereere e Paris mu kyasa ekye kkumi n’omusanvu. Yali muserikale, n’oluvannyuma omuweereza w’omu nnyumba, nga tannayingira nnyumba ya bamonaki, gye yamala emyaka mingi ng’afumba emmere, mu ffumbiro lye yagamba nti lyali limukyayisa nnyo mu butonde bwe. Eyo gye yayigira okubeera buli ssaawa wamu ne Katonda.

qa.question: Okwemanyiiza Okubeerawo kwa Katonda kitabo ki?
qa.answer: Kitabo kitono ekyakuŋŋaanyizibwa oluvannyuma lw’okufa kwa Brother Lawrence: emboozi ennya Joseph de Beaufort ze yawandiika ng’ayogera naye mu 1666 ne 1667, n’ebbaluwa ze kkumi na ttaano, ezisinga obungi ze yawandiika mu bukadde bwe eri mikwano gye abaali abalwadde oba abaali mu buzibu. Byonna wamu byogera ku kintu kimu ekyangu: okukyusiza omutima eri Katonda obutayosa, mu buli mulimu, ng’empisa ey’okumussaako omwoyo n’okwagala.

qa.question: Brother Lawrence yakyuka atya?
qa.answer: Mu mboozi esooka yabuulira de Beaufort nti bwe yali ow’emyaka kkumi na munaana, mu kiseera eky’obutiti, yalaba omuti ogwali gukaze ebikoola byagwo byonna. Bwe yalowooza nti mu bbanga ttono ebikoola byandizzeeyo, n’ebimuli n’ebibala ne birabika, n’afuna okumanya okw’ekitalo ku kulabirira kwa Katonda n’amaanyi ge. Yagamba nti okumanya okwo tekwamuvaako n’akatono, era kwamusumulula ku nsi.

qa.question: Okwemanyiiza okubeerawo kwa Katonda kitegeeza ki?
qa.answer: Eri Brother Lawrence kyategeezanga okwogera ne Katonda obutayosa era mu kasirise olunaku lwonna, ng’akola emirimu egya bulijjo olw’okumwagala. Yagamba nti Katonda yamubeerangamu n’emirembe mingi mu kuyoogaana n’okukubagana kw’ebintu mu ffumbiro lye, ng’abantu abawerako bamuyita omulundi gumu okubaleetera ebintu eby’enjawulo, nga bwe yandibadde ng’afukamidde mu maaso ga Ssakramentu. Ebiseera ebyateekebwawo eby’okusaba gy’ali tebyawukananga ku biseera ebirala.

qa.question: Brother Lawrence yakolanga ki bwe yagwanga mu nsobi?
qa.answer: Teyeebonyaabonyanga. Bwe yagwanga mu nsobi, yagyatulanga butereevu eri Katonda n’amugamba nti tagenda kukola bulala singa Katonda amuleka yekka, era nti kyali kya Katonda okumuziyiza okugwa n’okutereeza ekyonoonese. Oluvannyuma n’addayo ku mulimu gwe ne ku mpisa ye ey’okwagala Katonda, nga teyeeraliikirira olw’okulemererwa okwo.

qa.question: Lwaki ekitabo kino kyagalibwa okumala ebbanga eddene bwe lityo?
qa.answer: Kimpi, kyangu, si kya basomi, era tekisaba nkola za njawulo oba bifo bya njawulo, wabula omutima ogukyukidde Katonda mu mulimu gwonna oguli mu maaso go. Obwangu obwo bwakifuula ekisinga okwagalibwa Abakatoliki n’Abaprotestanti kyenkanyi okumala ebyasa ebisukka mu bisatu, n’abantu abakola ennyo abatasobola kugenda mu nnyumba ya bamonaki naye abaagala okubeera ne Katonda mu bulamu obwa bulijjo.

fields.title: Emboozi Esooka
fields.body_html:
Omulundi ogwasooka okulaba Brother Lawrence gwali nga 3 Agusito, 1666. Yaŋŋamba nti Katonda yamukolera ekisa eky’enjawulo ennyo bwe yakyuka ng’alina emyaka kkumi na munaana.

Nti mu kiseera eky’obutiti, bwe yalaba omuti ogwali gukaze ebikoola byagwo byonna, n’alowooza nti mu bbanga ttono ebikoola byandizzeeyo, oluvannyuma ebimuli n’ebibala ne birabika, n’afuna okumanya okw’ekitalo ku kulabirira kwa Katonda n’Amaanyi ge, okutaggwangako mu mmeeme ye okuva olwo. Nti okumanya okwo kwamusumulula ddala ku nsi, ne kumukoleezaamu okwagala Katonda kungi nnyo, ne kiba nti yali tasobola kumanya oba nga kweyongedde mu myaka egisoba mu ana gye yali amaze okuva olwo.

Nti yali muweereza w’omu nnyumba ya M. Fieubert, omuwanika, era nti yali musajja munene ow’ekiriiriri eyamenyanga buli kintu.

Nti yali yeegomba okuyingizibwa mu nnyumba y’abamonaki, ng’alowooza nti eyo bandimubonereza olw’ekiriiriri kye n’ensobi ze yandikoze, bw’atyo n’awaayo eri Katonda obulamu bwe n’essanyu lyabwo lyonna: naye Katonda n’amwewuunyisa, kubanga mu bulamu obwo teyasangamu kirala wabula essanyu.

Nti tusaanidde okunywerera mu kuwulira okubeerawo kwa Katonda, nga twogera naye obutayosa. Nti kyali kya nsonyi okulekayo okwogera naye, ne tulowooza ku bintu ebitaliimu n’eby’obusirusiru.

Nti tusaanidde okuliisa n’okuwanirira emmeeme zaffe n’endowooza ez’ekitiibwa ku Katonda; ezandituleetedde essanyu lingi mu kwewaayo gy’ali.

Nti tusaanidde okuzuukusa, kwe kugamba, okuzzaamu amaanyi okukkiriza kwaffe. Nti kyali kya nnaku nti tukulina kitono nnyo; era nti mu kifo ky’okufuula okukkiriza etteeka erifuga empisa zaabwe, abantu beemalira ku kusinza okw’ebweru okutaliimu, okukyukakyuka buli lunaku. Nti ekkubo ly’Okukkiriza gwe mwoyo gw’Ekkanisa, era nti limala okututuusa ku ddaala eriri waggulu ennyo ery’okutuukirira.

Nti tusaanidde okwewaayo eri Katonda mu bintu eby’omubiri n’eby’omwoyo, era tunoonye essanyu lyaffe mu kutuukiriza okwagala kwe kwokka, ka atukulembere mu kubonaabona oba mu kubudaabudibwa, kubanga byonna byandibadde bye bimu eri Emmeeme eyeewaddeyo ddala. Nti obwesigwa bwetaagibwa mu biseera ebyo eby’obukalu, oba eby’obutawulira kintu n’okukoowa mu kusaba, Katonda mw’agezesezza okwagala kwaffe gy’ali; nti olwo kye kiseera kye tusaanidde okukola ebikolwa eby’okwewaayo ebirungi era eby’amaanyi, ng’ekimu kyokka ku byo emirundi mingi kiyinza okutusitula ennyo mu kukula kwaffe okw’omwoyo.

Nti ku bikwata ku nnaku n’ebibi bye yawuliranga buli lunaku mu nsi, yali tabyewuunya n’akatono; wabula yeewuunyanga nti tebyali bingi okusingawo, bw’alowooza ku bubi aboonoonyi bwe basobola okukola; nti ye yabasabiranga; naye bwe yali amanyi nti Katonda asobola okutereeza obubi bwe bakola ekiseera kyonna ky’ayagala, teyeeteganyanga nate.

Nti okutuuka ku kwewaayo okw’engeri Katonda gy’ayagala, tusaanidde okwekuuma ennyo eri okwegomba kwonna okwetabula mu bintu eby’omwoyo era ne mu bintu eby’omubiri; nti Katonda yandiwadde ekitangaala ku kwegomba okwo abo abaagala ddala okumuweereza. Nti bwe kiba nti ekyo kye kigendererwa kyange, kwe kugamba, okuweereza Katonda mu mazima, nnyinza okujja gy’ali (Brother Lawrence) emirundi gyonna gye njagala, awatali kutya nti mmukooya; naye bwe kitaba bwe kityo, nti sisaanidde kuddamu kumukyalira.

fields.title: Emboozi Ey’okubiri
fields.body_html:
Nti bulijjo yali afugibwa kwagala, awatali kwenoonyeza; era nti bwe yamalirira okufuula okwagala Katonda ekigendererwa ky’ebikolwa bye byonna, yasanga ensonga nnyingi ez’okumatira n’enkola ye. Nti yasanyukanga bwe yasobolanga okulondawo akasubi ku ttaka “olw’okwagala Katonda, ng’anoonya Ye yekka, so si kirala kyonna, wadde ebirabo bye”.

Nti okumala ebbanga ddene yali atawaanyizibwa mu birowoozo olw’okukkiriza nti yali agenda kuzikirizibwa; nti abantu bonna ab’omu nsi tebandisobodde kumumatiza bulala; naye nti yeewoleza bw’ati ku nsonga eyo: Nnayingira mu bulamu bw’abamonaki olw’okwagala Katonda kwokka, era ngezezzaako okukola ku lulwe yekka; kale ka kibe ki ekinantuukako, ka mbe nga nzikirira oba nga ndokolebwa, nja kweyongeranga okukola olw’okwagala Katonda kwokka. Waakiri nja kuba n’ekirungi kino, nti okutuusa lwe ndifa nnaaba nkoze kyonna ekiri mu busobozi bwange okumwagala. Nti okutawaana kuno okw’omu birowoozo kwamala emyaka ena; era mu kiseera ekyo yabonaabona nnyo. Naye nti ku nkomerero yalaba nti okutawaana okwo kwava ku butaba na kukkiriza; era nti okuva olwo yamala obulamu bwe mu ddembe eddiyitirivu ne mu ssanyu eritakoma. Nti ebibi bye yabiteeka wakati we ne Katonda, ng’agamba Katonda nti tasaanira kisa kye, naye Katonda n’agenda mu maaso okumuwa ebirungi bye mu bungi.

Nti okusobola okufuna empisa ey’okwogera ne Katonda obutayosa, n’okumukwasa byonna bye tukola, tusaanidde mu kusooka okumunoonya n’obunyiikivu; naye nti oluvannyuma lw’okufaayo okutono twandisanze okwagala kwe nga kutukubiriza munda okukikola awatali buzibu bwonna.

Nti yasuubira nti oluvannyuma lw’ennaku ennungi Katonda ze yali amuwadde, yandifunye n’omugabo gwe ogw’obulumi n’okubonaabona; naye nti teyakyeraliikiriranga, ng’amanyi bulungi nti, nga bw’atasobola kukola kintu kyonna ku bubwe, Katonda teyandirema kumuwa maanyi okukigumira.

Nti bwe waabangawo omukisa ogw’okukola empisa ennungi, yeeyunanga eri Katonda ng’agamba nti, Mukama, sisobola kukola kino okuggyako ng’ompadde amaanyi: era nti olwo yafunanga amaanyi agasukkiridde.

Nti bwe yalemererwanga mu mulimu gwe, yatulanga butereevu ensobi ye, ng’agamba Katonda nti, Sijja kukola bulala, bw’onondekanga nzekka; ggwe olina okunziyiza okugwa, n’okutereeza ekyonoonese. Nti oluvannyuma lw’ekyo teyeeyongeranga kukyeraliikirira.

Nti tusaanidde okutambula ne Katonda mu bwangu obusingirayo ddala, nga twogera naye mu mazima era mu lwatu, nga tumwegayirira okutuyamba mu bintu byaffe, nga bwe bijja. Nti Katonda teyalemwanga kukikola, nga bwe yali akirabye emirundi mingi.

Nti yali yaakatumibwa e Burgundy, okugula omwenge ogw’ekibiina kyaffe, omulimu gwe yali tayagala n’akatono, kubanga teyalina kitone mu by’obusuubuzi, era kubanga yali mulema nga tasobola kutambula mu lyato okuggyako nga yeevulungula ku madebe. Nti naye teyakyeraliikirira, wadde okugula omwenge. Nti yagamba Katonda nti gwali mulimu gwa Katonda gwe yali akola, era nti oluvannyuma yasanga nga gukoleddwa bulungi nnyo. Nti omwaka ogwali gusoose yali atumiddwa e Auvergne, ku nsonga y’emu; nti yali tasobola kumanya nsonga bwe yatambula, naye nti yaggwa bulungi nnyo.

Bw’atyo ne mu mulimu gwe mu ffumbiro (lye yali akyawa ennyo mu butonde bwe), bwe yeemanyiiza okukola buli kimu eyo olw’okwagala Katonda, era ng’asaba buli kiseera ekisa kye okukola obulungi omulimu gwe, yasanga buli kimu nga kyangu, mu myaka kkumi na etaano gye yali amaze ng’akola omulimu ogwo.

Nti yali musanyufu nnyo n’omulimu gwe yali alina kati; naye nti yali mwetegefu okugulekayo nga bwe yaleka ogwasooka, kubanga bulijjo yasanyukanga mu buli mbeera, ng’akola obuntu obutono olw’okwagala Katonda.

Nti gy’ali ebiseera ebyateekebwawo eby’okusaba tebyawukananga ku biseera ebirala; nti yeeyawulanga okusaba, nga Omukulu w’ekibiina bwe yalagira, naye nti teyeetaaganga kweyawula okwo, era teyakusabanga, kubanga n’omulimu gwe ogusingira ddala obungi tegwamuggyanga ku Katonda.

Nti bwe yali amanyi obuvunaanyizibwa bwe obw’okwagala Katonda mu bintu byonna, era nga bw’agezaako okukola bw’atyo, teyeetaaga muluŋŋamya wa mwoyo okumuwa amagezi, naye nti yeetaaga nnyo kabona amuwulira ng’ayatula okumusonyiwa. Nti yali amanyi bulungi ensobi ze, naye nga tezimuggwaamu maanyi; nti yazatulanga eri Katonda, naye nga tamuwoleza kuzeekwasa nsonga. Bwe yamalanga okukola bw’atyo, yaddangayo mu mirembe ku mpisa ye eya bulijjo ey’okwagala n’okusinza.

Nti mu kutawaana kwe okw’omu birowoozo teyeebuuza ku muntu yenna, naye ng’amanyi mu kitangaala ky’okukkiriza kyokka nti Katonda yaliwo, n’amatira n’okulaga ebikolwa bye byonna eri Katonda, kwe kugamba, okubikola ng’ayagala okumusanyusa, ka kivemu ki.

Nti ebirowoozo ebitaliimu byonoona byonna: nti obubi bwe butandikira awo; naye nti tusaanidde okubigoba amangu ddala nga tukizudde nti tebikwatagana na mulimu oguli mu maaso gaffe, wadde n’obulokozi bwaffe; ne tuddayo mu kussa kimu kwaffe ne Katonda.

Nti mu kusooka emirundi mingi yamalanga ekiseera ekyateekebwawo eky’okusaba ng’agoba ebirowoozo ebiwaba, n’addamu okubigwamu. Nti teyasobola n’akatono kufuga kusinza kwe na nkola ezimu ng’abalala bwe bakola. Nti naye mu kusooka yali afumiitiriza okumala ekiseera, naye oluvannyuma ekyo ne kiggwaawo, mu ngeri gye yali tasobola kunnyonnyola.

Nti okwefiiriza kwonna okw’omubiri n’okwegezaamu okulala tekugasa, okuggyako nga kuyamba okutuuka ku kwegatta ne Katonda mu kwagala; nti ekyo yali akirowoozezzaako nnyo, era n’asanga nti lye kkubo erisinga obumpi okugenda butereevu gy’ali: okwagala obutayosa, n’okukola buli kimu ku lulwe.

Nti tusaanidde okwawulamu ennyo ebikolwa by’amagezi n’ebyo eby’okwagala kw’omutima: nti ebyasooka tebirina mugaso mungi bw’obigeraageranya, ate ebirala bye byonna. Nti omulimu gwaffe gwokka kwe kwagala Katonda n’okumusanyukiramu.

Nti okwefiiriza okw’engeri zonna eziyinza okubaawo, bwe kuba nga tekuliimu kwagala Katonda, tekusobola kusangula kibi na kimu. Nti tusaanidde, awatali kweraliikirira, okusuubira okusonyiyibwa ebibi byaffe okuva mu Musaayi gwa Yesu Kristo, nga tugezaako bugezi okumwagala n’emitima gyaffe gyonna. Nti Katonda yalabika ng’awadde ebirabo ebisinga obukulu aboonoonyi abasinga obubi, ng’obujulirwa obweyoleka obw’okusaasira kwe.

Nti obulumi oba essanyu ebisinga obunene mu nsi muno tebiyinza kugeraageranyizibwa n’ebyo bye yali alabye mu ngeri zombi mu bulamu obw’omwoyo: bw’atyo yali teyeeraliikirira kintu kyonna era nga tatya kintu kyonna, ng’asaba Katonda ekintu kimu kyokka, kwe kugamba, aleme kumunyiiza.

Nti yali talina kwetawaanya kwa muntu munda; kubanga, bwe yagamba, bwe ndemererwa mu mulimu gwange, mbikkiriza mangu, nga ŋŋamba nti, Nze bwe ntyo bwe nkola: sijja kukola bulala, bwe nnaalekebwanga nzekka. Bwe sirema, olwo nneebaza Katonda, nga nkkiriza nti amaanyi gava gy’ali.

fields.title: Emboozi Ey’okusatu
fields.body_html:
Yaŋŋamba nti omusingi gw’obulamu obw’omwoyo mu ye gwali endowooza ey’ekitiibwa ku Katonda n’okumussaamu ekitiibwa mu kukkiriza; ekyo bwe yamala okukitegeera obulungi, mu kusooka teyalina kirala kye yafaako, wabula okugoba n’obwesigwa buli kirowoozo ekirala, alyoke akole ebikolwa bye byonna olw’okwagala Katonda. Nti bwe waabangawo ekiseera ng’amaze akabanga nga talowoozezza ku Katonda, teyeetawaanyanga olw’ekyo; naye bwe yamalanga okwatula eri Katonda obunaku bwe, yaddangayo gy’ali ng’amwesiga nnyo okusinga, nga bwe yali yeesanze nga munaku olw’okumwerabira.

Nti okwesiga kwe tussa mu Katonda kumuwa ekitiibwa kingi, era kuleeta ekisa kingi.

Nti tekisoboka, si kwokka nti Katonda alimba, naye era nti aleka emmeeme okubonaabona okumala ebbanga eddene, nga yeewaddeyo ddala gy’ali, era nga emaliridde okugumira buli kimu ku lulwe.

Nti yali alabye emirundi mingi nnyo obuyambi bw’Ekisa kya Katonda nga bujja mangu mu buli mbeera, ne kiba nti olw’okumanya okwo, bwe yabanga n’omulimu ogw’okukola, teyagulowoozangako ng’ekiseera tekinnatuuka; naye ekiseera bwe kyatuukanga, yasanganga mu Katonda, ng’alinga atunuulira mu ndabirwamu entangaavu, byonna bye yali agwanidde okukola. Nti mu biseera ebyo eby’oluvannyuma yakolanga bw’atyo, nga teyeeraliikiridde nga bukyali; naye nga tannalaba bye twogeddeko waggulu, yeeraliikiriranga mu nsonga ze.

Emirimu egy’ebweru bwe gyamuggyangako katono ku kulowooza ku Katonda, okujjukira okuggya okuva eri Katonda kwamujjulangamu emmeeme, ne kumwokya era ne kumusitula nnyo ne kiba nti kyamuzibuwaliranga okwefuga.

Nti yali yeegasse nnyo ne Katonda mu mirimu gye egy’ebweru okusinga bwe yagirekanga n’agenda okusinza mu kifo eky’ekyama.

Nti yasuubira mu biseera eby’omu maaso obulumi obw’amaanyi mu mubiri oba mu mutima; nti ekintu ekisinga obubi ekyandimutuuseeko kwali kufiirwa okuwulira okwo okwa Katonda kwe yali amaze okusanyukira okumala ebbanga eddene; naye nti obulungi bwa Katonda bwamukakasa nti teyandimulese ddala, era nti yandimuwadde amaanyi okugumira obubi bwonna Katonda bwe yandikkirizza okumutuukako; n’olwekyo yali tatya kintu kyonna, era nga talina nsonga emwetaagisa kwebuuza ku muntu yenna ku mbeera ye. Nti bwe yagezangako okukikola, bulijjo yavangayo ng’asobeddwa nnyo okusingawo; era nti nga bwe yali amanyi nti mwetegefu okuwaayo obulamu bwe olw’okwagala Katonda, yali tatya kabi konna. Nti okwewaayo ddala eri Katonda kkubo lya nkakafu eridda mu ggulu, ekkubo mwe tubeerera bulijjo n’ekitangaala ekimala okutulungamya.

Nti mu ntandikwa y’obulamu obw’omwoyo, tusaanidde okuba abeesigwa mu kukola emirimu gyaffe n’okwefiiriza; naye oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, essanyu eritayogerekeka ne liddirira; nti mu bizibu tetwetaaga kirala okuggyako okuddukira eri Yesu Kristo, ne tumwegayirira ekisa kye; era ng’ekyo kiriwo, buli kimu ne kyanguwa.

Nti bangi tebakulaakulana mu kkubo ly’Ekikristaayo kubanga basibira mu kwebonereza, ne mu kwegezaamu okw’enjawulo, ate ne balagajjalira okwagala Katonda, kwe kigendererwa. Nti kino kyalabikira bulungi mu bikolwa byabwe, era kye kyali ensonga lwaki tulaba empisa ennungi entongole ntono nnyo.

Nti okugenda eri Katonda tekwetaaga bukugu wadde magezi ga kusoma, wabula omutima gwokka ogumaliridde ddala obuteemalira ku kintu kirala kyonna okuggyako Ye, oba ku lulwe, n’okwagala Ye yekka.

fields.title: Emboozi Ey’okuna
fields.body_html:
Yayogeranga nange emirundi mingi nnyo, era n’omutima ogwerufu ddala, ku ngeri ye ey’okugenda eri Katonda, ekitundu kyayo kye tumaze okunnyonnyola.

Yaŋŋamba nti byonna biri mu kwerekereza okumu okw’omutima gwonna buli kintu kye tumanyi nti tekitutuusa eri Katonda; tulyoke twemanyiize okwogera naye obutayosa, mu ddembe ne mu bwangu. Nti tetwetaaga kirala okuggyako okutegeera nti Katonda ali naffe kumpi ddala munda, okwogera naye buli kaseera, tulyoke tumwegayirire atuyambe okumanya by’ayagala mu bintu bye tubuusabuusa, n’okukola obulungi ebyo bye tulaba obulungi nti abitwetaagisa, nga tubimuwa nga tetunnabikola, era nga tumwebaza nga tumaze okubikola.

Nti mu kwogera kuno ne Katonda, tuba era nga tumutendereza, nga tumusinza era nga tumwagala obutakoma, olw’obulungi bwe obutaliiko kkomo n’obutuukirivu bwe.

Nti, awatali kuggwaamu maanyi olw’ebibi byaffe, tusaanidde okusaba ekisa kye n’obwesige obutuukiridde, nga twesigama ku birungi ebitaliiko kkomo ebya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Nti Katonda teyalemanga kutuwa kisa kye mu buli kikolwa; nti ye yakiwuliranga bulungi, era teyakibulwanga, okuggyako ng’ebirowoozo bye biwabye ne biva ku kuwulira okubeerawo kwa Katonda, oba nga yeerabidde okumusaba amuyambe.

Nti bulijjo Katonda yatuwanga ekitangaala mu kubuusabuusa kwaffe, bwe twabanga tetulina kigendererwa kirala wabula okwagala okumusanyusa.

Nti okutukuzibwa kwaffe tekwesigama ku kukyusa mirimu gyaffe, wabula ku kukola ku lwa Katonda ebyo bye tutera okukola ku lwaffe. Nti kyali kya nnaku okulaba abantu bangi bwe batabulatabula ekkubo n’ekigendererwa, ne beemalira ku mirimu egimu, gye baakolanga mu ngeri etatuukiridde n’akatono, olw’ebigendererwa byabwe eby’obuntu oba eby’okwenoonyeza.

Nti enkola esinga obulungi gye yali azudde ey’okugenda eri Katonda, yali ey’okukola emirimu gyaffe egya bulijjo nga tetugenderera kusanyusa bantu,* era (nga bwe tusobola) olw’okwagala Katonda kwokka.

Nti kyali kwerimbalimba kunene okulowooza nti ebiseera eby’okusaba bisaanidde okwawukana ku biseera ebirala: nti tuvunaanyizibwa kyenkanyi okunywerera ku Katonda mu bikolwa mu kiseera eky’okukola, nga bwe tumunywererako mu kusaba mu kiseera eky’okusaba.

Nti okusaba kwe tekwali kirala wabula okuwulira okubeerawo kwa Katonda, emmeeme ye mu kiseera ekyo nga tewulira kintu kirala kyonna okuggyako okwagala kwa Katonda: era nti ebiseera ebyateekebwawo eby’okusaba bwe byayitangawo, teyalabanga njawulo, kubanga yasigalanga ne Katonda, ng’amutendereza era ng’amwebaza n’amaanyi ge gonna, bw’atyo n’amala obulamu bwe mu ssanyu eritakoma; naye ng’asuubira nti Katonda yandimuwadde ekintu eky’okubonaabona, bwe yandibadde ayongedde amaanyi.

Nti tusaanidde, omulundi gumu ogw’enkomerero, okussa n’omutima gwonna obwesige bwaffe bwonna mu Katonda, ne twewaayo ddala gy’ali, nga tukakasa nti tajja kutulimba.

Nti tetusaanidde kukoowa kukola buntu butono olw’okwagala Katonda, atatunuulira bunene bwa mulimu, wabula okwagala okugukolwamu. Nti tetusaanidde kwewuunya bwe tulemererwa emirundi mingi mu kugezaako kwaffe mu ntandikwa, naye nti ku nkomerero twandifunye empisa, eneereetanga ebikolwa byayo mu ffe mu ngeri ey’obutonde, awatali kufaayo kwaffe, era nga tusanyuka nnyo ddala.

Nti ensonga y’eddiini yonna yali kukkiriza, essuubi n’okwagala; nga tubikola tugattibwa n’okwagala kwa Katonda: nti ebirala byonna si bikulu, era bikozesebwa ng’ekkubo okututuusa ku kigendererwa kyaffe, era tumirirwe omwo, mu kukkiriza ne mu kwagala.

Nti buli kimu kisoboka eri oyo akkiriza—nti tekizibuwala nnyo eri oyo alina essuubi—nti kyanguwa okusingawo eri oyo ayagala, era kyanguwa nnyo okusingira ddala eri oyo anyiikira mu kukola empisa zino essatu.

Nti ekigendererwa kye tusaanidde okwetegekera kwe kuba, mu bulamu buno, abasinza ba Katonda abasinga okutuukirira nga bwe tusobola okuba, nga bwe tusuubira okuba emirembe gyonna.

Nti bwe tuyingira mu bulamu obw’omwoyo, tusaanidde okulowooza, n’okwekenneenya okutuuka wansi ddala, kye tuli. Olwo twandyesanze nga tusaanira okunyoomebwa kwonna, era nga mazima tetusaanira na linnya lya Bakristaayo: nga tuli wansi w’ennaku ez’engeri zonna n’obuzibu obutabalika, ebitutawaanya era ebireeta enkyukakyuka ezitakoma mu bulamu bwaffe, mu mbeera zaffe ez’omutima, mu ndowooza zaffe ez’omunda n’ez’ebweru; mu bufunze, abantu Katonda b’ayagala okukkakkanya ng’ayita mu bulumi n’emitawaana mingi, munda n’ebweru. Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo tetwandyewuunyizza nti ebizibu, okukemebwa, okuziyizibwa n’okuwakanyizibwa bitutuukako okuva eri abantu. Wabula, tusaanidde okubyewaayo, ne tubigumiikiriza okumala ekiseera kyonna Katonda ky’ayagala, ng’ebintu ebitugasa ennyo.

Nti emmeeme gy’ekoma okwegomba obutuukirivu obusingawo, gy’ekoma okwesigama ku kisa kya Katonda.

†Bwe yabuuzibwa omu ku b’ekibiina kye (gwe yali alina okwebikkulira) engeri gye yali atuuse ku kuwulira Katonda okwo okw’olubeerera, yamugamba nti, okuva lwe yasooka okujja mu nnyumba y’abamonaki, yali atwala Katonda ng’ekigendererwa ky’ebirowoozo bye byonna n’okwegomba kwe, ng’akabonero ke byalina okulaga, era mwe byalina okukoma.

Nti mu ntandikwa y’obuyizi bwe ng’omumonaki omuggya, yamalanga essaawa ezaateekebwawo ez’okusaba mu kyama ng’alowooza ku Katonda, alyoke amatize amagezi ge, era akuŋŋaanye mu mutima gwe, okubeerawo kwa Katonda, okusinga mu kuwulira okw’okusinza n’okugondera ebitangaala by’okukkiriza, okusinga mu kulowooza okw’okusoma n’okufumiitiriza okuwanvu. Nti mu nkola eno ennyimpi era ey’enkakafu, yeegezangamu okumanya Katonda n’okumwagala, ng’amaliridde okukozesa amaanyi ge gonna okubeera mu kuwulira okubeerawo kwe obutayosa, era bwe kiba kisoboka, obutaddayo kumwerabira.

Nti bwe yamalanga okujjuza amagezi ge mu kusaba n’endowooza ez’ekitiibwa ku Oyo Atalina Kkomo, yagendanga ku mulimu gwe ogwamuweebwa mu ffumbiro (kubanga ye yali omufumbi w’ekibiina); eyo bwe yamalanga okusooka okulowooza kinnakimu ku bintu omulimu gwe bye gwetaagisa, era ddi n’engeri buli kimu gye kyalina okukolebwamu, yamalanga ebiseera byonna ebyayitangawo, nga tannakola era ng’amaze okukola, mu kusaba.

Nti bwe yatandikanga omulimu gwe, yagambanga Katonda, n’obwesige bw’omwana eri kitaawe, nti, “Ai Katonda wange, nga bw’oli nange, era nga kaakano nteekwa, mu kugondera ebiragiro byo, okussa amagezi gange ku bintu bino eby’ebweru, nkwegayiridde ompe ekisa okusigala mu Kubeerawo kwo; era olw’ekyo onnyambe, ofune emirimu gyange gyonna, era ofuge okwagala kwange kwonna.”

Bwe yagendanga mu maaso n’omulimu gwe, yeeyongeranga okwogera n’Omutonzi we ng’omukwano ow’oku lusegere,—ng’amwegayirira ekisa kye, era ng’amuwa ebikolwa bye byonna.

Bwe yamalanga, yeekebereranga engeri gye yatuukirizza omulimu gwe; bwe yasanganga nga kirungi, yeebazanga Katonda; bwe kitaabanga bwe kityo, yeegayiriranga okusonyiyibwa; era awatali kuggwaamu maanyi, yazzangamu amagezi ge mu kkubo, n’agenda mu maaso n’okwegezaamu kwe okw’okubeerawo kwa Katonda, ng’alinga atabivangako. “Bwe ntyo,” bwe yagamba, “nga nnyimuka oluvannyuma lw’okugwa kwange, era nga nzzaawo emirundi mingi ebikolwa eby’okukkiriza n’okwagala, ntuuse ku mbeera nga kyandinzibuwalidde obutalowooza ku Katonda nga bwe kyanzibuwalira mu kusooka okukyemanyiiza.”

Nga Brother Lawrence bwe yali azudde omugaso omunene bwe gutyo mu kutambulira mu maaso ga Katonda, kyali kya butonde gy’ali okukisemba ennyo eri abalala; naye ekyokulabirako kye kyabakubirizanga okusinga ensonga zonna ze yandiyinzizza okubawa. Ne ku maaso ge kwennyini kwazimbanga abantu, kubanga kwalabikangako okusinza okw’obukakkamu n’emirembe, ne kiba nti abaamulabanga tebaayinza kulema kukwatibwako. Era kyalabibwa nti ne mu kiseera ekisinga okujjula emirimu mu ffumbiro, yasigalanga ng’ebirowoozo bye bikuŋŋaanye ku Katonda era ng’alowooza ku by’omu ggulu. Teyapapanga era teyagayaalanga, wabula yakolanga buli kintu mu kiseera kyakyo, n’obukkakkamu obutakyukakyuka era obutasalikasalika n’emirembe mu mwoyo. “Ekiseera eky’emirimu,” bwe yagamba, “gyendi tekyawukana ku kiseera eky’okusaba; era mu kuyoogaana n’okukubagana kw’ebintu mu ffumbiro lyange, ng’abantu abawerako mu kiseera kye kimu bampita okubaleetera ebintu eby’enjawulo, Katonda mmubeeramu n’emirembe mingi nga gye nnandibadde nagyo singa mbadde nfukamidde ku Ssakramentu eritukuvu.”

* Abaggalatiya 1:10; Abaefeso 6:5-6.

† Ebigambo ebiddirira byakuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva mu bigambo ebirala ebyawandiikibwa ku Brother Lawrence.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Esooka
fields.body_html:
Okuva bw’oyagala ennyo bw’otyo nkubuulire enkola gye nnayitamu okutuuka ku kuwulira okw’olubeerera okw’Okubeerawo kwa Katonda, Mukama waffe kwe yasiima, olw’okusaasira kwe, okumpa, nteekwa okukubuulira nti kinzibuwalidde nnyo okukkiriza olw’okunkubiriza kwo emirundi n’emirundi; era kaakano nkikola ku kakwakkulizo kamu kokka: tolaga bbaluwa yange muntu yenna. Singa nnali mmanyi nti ojja kugiraga abalala, okwegomba kwonna kwe nnina olw’okukulaakulana kwo tekwandisobodde kunsalawo kukikola. Bye nsobola okukubuulira bye bino:

Bwe nnasanga mu bitabo bingi enkola ez’enjawulo ez’okugenda eri Katonda, n’engeri ez’enjawulo ez’okwegezaamu obulamu obw’omwoyo, nnalowooza nti zino zandinsobezza okusinga okunyanguyiza kye nnali nnoonya, ekyali kitali kirala wabula engeri y’okufuuka owa Katonda ddala. Kino kyandeetera okumalirira okuwaayo byonna olw’Oyo byonna; bwe ntyo bwe nnamala okwewaayo ddala eri Katonda, alyoke anziggyeko ekibi kyange, nnalekayo, olw’okumwagala, buli kintu ekitali Ye; ne ntandika okubeera ng’alinga mu nsi temuli mulala okuggyako Ye nange. Oluusi neetunuuliranga mu maaso ge ng’omusingi omwavu eyimiridde ku bigere by’omulamuzi we; ebiseera ebirala nnamulabanga mu mutima gwange nga Kitange, nga Katonda wange: nnamusinzanga emirundi gyonna gye nnasobola, nga nkuuma amagezi gange mu Kubeerawo kwe okutukuvu, era nga ngazzaawo buli lwe nnasanga nti gawabye ne gamuvaako. Nnafuna obulumi si butono mu kwegezaamu kuno, naye ne ngenda mu maaso nakwo, newaakubadde nga waaliwo ebizibu byonna, nga seetawaanya era nga seeraliikirira amagezi gange bwe gaawabanga nga sigenderedde. Kino nnakifuula omulimu gwange olunaku lwonna nga bwe kyali mu biseera ebyateekebwawo eby’okusaba; kubanga mu biseera byonna, buli ssaawa, buli dakiika, ne mu kiseera ekisinga okujjula emirimu, nnagobanga mu magezi gange buli kintu ekyali kiyinza okutaataaganya okulowooza kwange ku Katonda.

Eyo y’ebadde empisa yange eya bulijjo okuva lwe nnayingira mu bulamu bw’abamonaki; era, newaakubadde nga nkikoze mu ngeri etatuukiridde n’akatono, kyokka nfunye emigaso mingi mu kyo. Gino, mmanyi bulungi, gisaanidde okubalirwa ku kusaasira n’obulungi bwa Katonda bwokka, kubanga tetusobola kukola kintu kyonna awatali Ye; era nze nsingira ddala abalala bonna obutasobola. Naye bwe tuba abeesigwa okwekuuma mu Kubeerawo kwe okutukuvu, ne tumuteeka bulijjo mu maaso gaffe, kino tekituziyiza kwokka okumunyiiza n’okukola ekintu kyonna ekiyinza okumunyiiza, waakiri mu bugenderevu, naye era kituzaalamu eddembe ettukuvu, era, bwe nnyinza okwogera bwe ntyo, omukwano ogw’oku lusegere ne Katonda, mwe tusabira, era ne tufuna, ekisa kye twetaaga. Mu bufunze, bwe tuddiŋŋana ebikolwa bino emirundi mingi, bifuuka mpisa, n’okubeerawo kwa Katonda ne kufuuka ng’ekintu eky’obutonde gye tuli. Mwebaze, bw’oba oyagala, wamu nange, olw’obulungi bwe obungi gye ndi, bwe sisobola kwewuunya ekimala, olw’ebirungi ebingi by’ankoledde, nze omwonoonyi omunaku bwe nti. Ebintu byonna bimutendereze. Amiina.

Nze, mu Mukama waffe, owuwo, n’ebirala.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Ey’okubiri
fields.body_html:
Eri Omuweesimwa—

Bwe sisanze nkola yange ey’obulamu mu bitabo, newaakubadde nga sirina buzibu bwonna nayo, naye, olw’obukakafu obusingawo, nandisanyuse okumanya ky’ogirowoozaako.

Mu mboozi gye nnayogera ennaku ntono emabega n’omuntu atya Katonda, yaŋŋamba nti obulamu obw’omwoyo bulamu bwa kisa, obutandika n’okutya okw’obuddu, ne bweyongera olw’essuubi ly’obulamu obutaggwaawo, era ne butuukirizibwa mu kwagala okulongoofu. Nti buli mbeera ku zino erina amadaala gaayo ag’enjawulo, omuntu g’ayitamu okutuuka ku nkomerero ku kutuukirizibwa okwo okw’omukisa.

Enkola zino zonna sizigoberedde. Wabula, olw’ekirowoozo ekimu ekyava munda gye simanyi, nnazisanga nga zinzigyamu amaanyi. Eno ye yali ensonga lwaki, bwe nnayingira mu bulamu bw’abamonaki, nnamalirira okwewaayo eri Katonda, ng’ekyo kye kisinga obulungi kye nnali nsobola okumuddiza olw’okwagala kwe; era, olw’okumwagala, okulekayo ebirala byonna.

Mu mwaka ogwasooka, mu biseera ebyateekebwawo eby’okusinza nnatera okwemalira ku kulowooza ku kufa, okusalirwa omusango, eggulu, ggeyeena, n’ebibi byange. Bwe ntyo ne ngenda mu maaso okumala emyaka egimu, nga nssa n’obwegendereza amagezi gange, olunaku lwonna olusigaddeyo, ne wakati mu mirimu gyange, ku kubeerawo kwa Katonda, gwe nnatwalanga bulijjo nga ali nange, era emirundi mingi nga ali munda mu nze.

Ku nkomerero, mpolampola nga simanyi, ne ntandika okukola ekintu kye kimu mu kiseera kyange ekyateekebwawo eky’okusaba, ekyandeetera essanyu lingi n’okubudaabudibwa. Empisa eno yanzaalamu okussa ekitiibwa kingi mu Katonda, ne kiba nti okukkiriza kwokka kwe kwali kusobola okummatiza mu nsonga eyo.*

Eyo ye yali entandikwa yange; kyokka nteekwa okukubuulira nti mu myaka ekkumi egyasooka nnabonaabona nnyo: okutya nti saali mwewaayo eri Katonda nga bwe nnali njagala, ebibi byange eby’edda nga bibeera bulijjo mu birowoozo byange, n’ebirungi ebinene Katonda bye yankoleranga bye saasaaniranga, bye byali ensibuko y’okubonaabona kwange. Mu kiseera ekyo nnagwanga emirundi mingi, ne nnyimuka mangu. Kyandabikiranga nti ebitonde byonna, amagezi, ne Katonda yennyini byali bimpakanya; era nga okukkiriza kwokka kwe kwali ku ludda lwange. Oluusi nnatawaanyizibwanga ebirowoozo nti okukkiriza nti nnali nfunye ebirungi ng’ebyo kyali kiva mu kwekulumbaza kwange, okwali kwefuula okuba omulundi gumu abalala we batuuka n’obuzibu; ebiseera ebirala nti kwali kwerimbalimba kwa bugenderevu, era nti nze saalina bulokozi.

Bwe nnali sirowooza kirala wabula okumaliriza ennaku zange mu kutawaana kuno (okutaakendeeza n’akatono obwesige bwe nnalina mu Katonda, era okwayongeranga bwongezi okukkiriza kwange), nnesanga nga nkyuse omulundi gumu; era emmeeme yange, eyali okutuusa mu kiseera ekyo mu kutawaana, n’ewulira emirembe egy’omunda egy’obuziba, ng’alinga etuuse mu makkati gaayo ne mu kifo kyayo eky’okuwummuliramu.

Okuva mu kiseera ekyo ntambula mu maaso ga Katonda mu bwangu, mu kukkiriza, n’obwetoowaze n’okwagala; era nfuba nnyo obutakola kintu kyonna wadde okulowooza ekintu kyonna ekiyinza okumunyiiza. Nsuubira nti bwe nnaaba nkoze kye nsobola, ajja kunkolera ky’ayagala.

Ku ebyo ebibeera mu nze kaakano, sisobola kubyogera. Sirina bulumi wadde obuzibu ku mbeera yange, kubanga sirina kwagala kulala okuggyako okwa Katonda, kwe nfuba okutuukiriza mu bintu byonna, era kwe nneewaddeyo ddala ne kiba nti sandironzeewo kasubi ku ttaka nga kikontana n’ekiragiro kye, oba olw’ensonga endala yonna okuggyako okumwagala kwokka.

Ndese engeri zonna ez’okusinza n’essaala ezisomebwa, okuggyako ezo embeera yange z’enteekawo. Era omulimu gwange gwokka kwe kunyiikira mu kubeerawo kwe okutukuvu, mwe nneekuumira nga mmussaako omwoyo mu ngeri ennyangu, era nga mmutunuulira n’okwagala okw’awamu, kwe nnyinza okuyita okubeerawo okwennyini okwa Katonda; oba, okwogera obulungi, okwogera kw’emmeeme ne Katonda okw’olubeerera, okw’akasirise era okw’ekyama, ekitera okundeetera essanyu n’okusamaalirira munda, era oluusi n’ebweru, ebinene ennyo, ne kiba nti nteekwa okukozesa engeri ez’okubikendeeza n’okubiziyiza okulabibwa abalala.

Mu bufunze, nkakasa awatali kubuusabuusa kwonna nti emmeeme yange ebadde ne Katonda okumala emyaka egisoba mu asatu. Mbuuka ebintu bingi nneme kukukooya, naye ndowooza nti kirungi okukutegeeza engeri gye neetunuuliramu mu maaso ga Katonda, gwe ntunuulira nga Kabaka wange.

Neetwala ng’omuntu asingira ddala obunaku mu bantu bonna, ajjudde amabwa n’obuvundu, era eyakola ebisobyo eby’engeri zonna eri Kabaka we; nga nkwatiddwako ennaku ey’amazima, mmwatulira obubi bwange bwonna, mmusaba ansonyiwe, neewaayo mu mikono gye ankole ky’ayagala. Kabaka, ajjudde okusaasira n’obulungi, mu kifo ky’okumbonereza, ampambaatira n’okwagala, anfuula alya ku mmeeza ye, ampeereza n’emikono gye ye, ampa ekisumuluzo ky’amawanika ge; ayogera nange era asanyukira mu nze obutakoma, mu ngeri lukumi n’olukumi, era anjisa mu buli ngeri ng’omwagalwa we. Bwe ntyo bwe neetunuulira buli kiseera mu kubeerawo kwe okutukuvu.

Enkola yange esinga omugaso kwe kumussaako omwoyo mu ngeri eno ennyangu, n’okumutunuulira n’okwagala okw’awamu okw’amaanyi; gwe nneesanga nga nneekwatiddeko emirundi mingi n’obuwoomi n’essanyu okusinga ebyo eby’omwana ku bbeere lya nnyina; ne kiba nti, bwe nnyinza okugezaako okukozesa ekigambo ekyo, nandironze okuyita embeera eno ekifuba kya Katonda, olw’obuwoomi obutayogerekeka bwe mpoomerwa era bwe mpulira eyo.

Ebirowoozo byange bwe bigiwaba oluusi olw’obwetaavu oba olw’obunafu, mangu ddala nkomezebwawo okusikirizibwa okw’omunda okulungi ennyo era okuwoomu ennyo, ne kiba nti nkwatibwa ensonyi okukwogerako. Nkwegayiridde, Omuweesimwa, olowooze ku bunaku bwange obunene, bw’omanyi obulungi, okusinga ku birungi ebinene Katonda by’ankolera, nze atasaanira era atasiima bwe nti.

Ku ssaawa zange ezaateekebwawo ez’okusaba, zibeera kugenda mu maaso bugenzi n’okwegezaamu okwo kwe kumu. Oluusi neetunuulira eyo ng’ejjinja mu maaso g’omubazzi, gw’agenda okukolamu ekifaananyi; bwe neewaayo bwe ntyo mu maaso ga Katonda, mmwegayirira akole ekifaananyi kye ekituukiridde mu mmeeme yange, era anfuule ddala nga ye.

Ebiseera ebirala, bwe neemalira ku kusaba, mpulira omwoyo gwange gwonna n’emmeeme yange yonna nga byesitula waggulu awatali kufaayo kwange wadde okufuba kwange, era ne bisigala ng’ebiwanikiddwa era ebinywevu mu Katonda, ng’ali mu makkati gaabyo ne mu kifo kyabyo eky’okuwummuliramu.

Mmanyi nti abamu bawawaabira embeera eno nti bugayaavu, kwerimbalimba n’okwagala obwannakyemalira. Nzikiriza nti bugayaavu butukuvu, era bwandibadde kwagala obwannakyemalira okw’essanyu, singa emmeeme mu mbeera eyo yali esobola okukwagala; kubanga, mu butuufu, nga ewummudde bw’etyo, teyinza kutaataaganyizibwa bikolwa ebyo bye yali yamanyiira edda, era ebyali biyamba okugiwanirira mu kiseera ekyo, naye ebyandigiziyizza kaakano okusinga okugiyamba.

Naye siyinza kugumiikiriza kino kuyitibwa kwerimbalimba; kubanga emmeeme esanyukira mu Katonda bw’etyo temuli kye yeegomba okuggyako Ye. Bwe kiba nga kuno kwerimbalimba mu nze, kya Katonda okukutereeza. Ankole ky’ayagala; njagala Ye yekka, era okwewaayo ddala gy’ali. Naye ojja kunkolera ekisa bw’onompeereza endowooza yo, gye nzisaamu ekitiibwa kingi bulijjo, kubanga nkussaamu ekitiibwa eky’enjawulo, Omuweesimwa, era nze, mu Mukama waffe,

Owuwo, n’ebirala.

* Ndowooza ategeeza nti endowooza zonna entongole ze yali asobola okufuna ku Katonda tezaamumatizanga, kubanga yalaba nga tezisaanira Katonda; n’olwekyo amagezi ge gaali tegayinza kumatira okuggyako mu ebyo okukkiriza bye kulaba, okutegeera Katonda nga Atalina Kkomo era Atategeerekeka, nga bw’ali mu Ye kennyini, so si nga bw’ayinza okulowoozebwa mu ndowooza z’abantu.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Ey’okusatu
fields.body_html:
Tulina Katonda ow’ekisa ekitaliiko kkomo, amanyi byonna bye twetaaga. Bulijjo nnalowoozanga nti yandikutuusizza ku nkomerero y’amaanyi go. Ajja kujja mu kiseera kye, era nga tosuubira n’akatono. Musuubire okusinga bwe wali obadde; mwebaze wamu nange olw’ebirungi by’akukolera, naddala olw’obugumu n’obugumiikiriza by’akuwa mu kubonaabona kwo. Ako kabonero akalabika bulungi akalaga nti akufaako. Kale weebudaabude naye, era weebaze olwa byonna.

Era nneewuunya obuvumu n’obuzira bwa Mwami ——. Katonda amuwadde empisa ennungi n’omutima omulungi; naye mu ye mukyalimu akatono ak’ensi, n’obuvubuka bungi. Nsuubira nti ekibonoobono Katonda ky’amuweerezza kijja kumubeerera eddagala erimuganya, kimuleetere okwekebera munda. Kino kibaddewo ekisaanidde okumukubiriza okussa obwesige bwe bwonna mu Oyo amuwerekerera buli wamu. Amulowoozengako emirundi emingi nga bw’asobola, naddala mu bulabe obusinga obunene. Okusitula katono omutima kumala. Okujjukira katono Katonda, ekikolwa kimu eky’okusinza okw’omunda, ne bw’aba ng’atambula mu lutalo, ng’ekitala kiri mu ngalo, ziba ssaala, ne bwe ziba nnyimpi zitya, naye nga Katonda azisiima nnyo; era mu kifo ky’okukendeeza ku buvumu bw’omuserikale mu biseera eby’obulabe, ze zisinga okubunyweza.

Kale alowoozenga ku Katonda nga bw’asobola okusingawo. Yeemanyiize, mpolampola, okwegezaamu kuno okutono naye okutukuvu. Tewali ajja kukiraba, era tewali kyangu okusinga okuddiŋŋana emirundi mingi olunaku lwonna okusinza kuno okutono okw’omunda. Mukubirize, bw’oba oyagala, alowoozenga ku Katonda nga bw’asobola okusingawo, mu ngeri eyo gye mmaze okulaga. Kisaanidde nnyo era kyetaagisa nnyo eri omuserikale, buli lunaku ali mu bulabe bw’okufiirwa obulamu. Nsuubira nti Katonda ajja kumuyamba ne b’omu maka ge bonna, be ntumira okulamusa kwange, nga ndi wuwe era, Owuwo, n’ebirala.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Ey’okuna
fields.body_html:
Nkozesezza omukisa guno okukubuulira endowooza z’omu ku b’ekibiina kyaffe, ku bivaamu eby’ekitalo n’obuyambi obutakoma bw’afuna okuva mu kubeerawo kwa Katonda. Ka ffembi tubiganyulwemu.

Kimanye nti okufaayo kwe okw’olubeerera, okumala emyaka nga ana egiyise gy’amaze mu bulamu bw’abamonaki, kubadde kwa kubeera bulijjo ne Katonda, n’obutakola kintu kyonna, obutayogera kintu kyonna, n’obutalowooza kintu kyonna ekiyinza okumunyiiza; era ekyo awatali kigendererwa kirala kyonna wabula olw’okumwagala kwokka, era kubanga asaanira okusingawo awatali kkomo.

Kaakano amanyidde nnyo Okubeerawo kwa Katonda okwo, ne kiba nti afunayo obuyambi obutakoma mu buli mbeera. Okumala emyaka nga asatu, emmeeme ye ebadde ejjudde essanyu eritakoma, era oluusi eddene ennyo, ne kiba nti ateekwa okukozesa engeri ez’okulikendeeza, n’okuliziyiza okulabika ebweru.

Bw’aba oluusi abuze katono nnyo ku Kubeerawo kwa Katonda okwo, Katonda amangu ddala yeewulizisa mu mmeeme ye okumukomyawo, ekitera okubaawo ng’asinga okuba mu mirimu gye egy’ebweru. Addamu n’obwesigwa obutuukiridde okusikirizibwa kuno okw’omunda, oba ng’asitula omutima gwe eri Katonda, oba ng’amutunuulira n’obukkakkamu n’okwagala, oba n’ebigambo okwagala bye kutonda mu biseera ebyo, ng’okugeza, Katonda wange, nze wuuno, ndi wuwo ddala: Mukama, onfuule nga omutima gwo bwe gwagala. Olwo kimulabikira (era mazima bw’akiwulira) nti Katonda ono ow’okwagala, ng’amatidde n’ebigambo ebitono bwe bityo, addamu okuwummula, era awummulira munda ddala ne mu makkati g’emmeeme ye. Okumanya ebintu bino kumuwa obukakafu bungi nnyo nti Katonda bulijjo ali munda ddala mu mmeeme ye, ne kiba nti tasobola kukibuusabuusa olw’ensonga yonna.

Lowooza ku kino omanye essanyu n’okumatira by’afuna ng’asanga bulijjo mu ye obugagga obunene bwe butyo. Takyabunoonya n’okweraliikirira, wabula abulina nga bubikkuliddwa mu maaso ge, era asobola okutwalako ky’ayagala.

Yeemulugunya nnyo olw’obuzibe bwaffe, era emirundi mingi akaaba nti tusaanidde okusaasirwa ffe abamatira n’ekitono bwe kityo. Katonda, bw’agamba, alina obugagga obutaliiko kkomo obw’okugaba, naffe ne tumatira n’okusinza okutono okw’okuwulira, okuggwaawo mu kaseera katono. Nga bwe tuli bamuzibe, tuziyiza Katonda, ne tuziyiza n’okukulukuta kw’ekisa kye. Naye bw’asanga emmeeme eyingiddwamu okukkiriza okulamu, agifukamu ekisa kye n’ebirungi bye mu bungi: eyo bikulukuta ng’omugga ogw’amaanyi, ogwo, oluvannyuma lw’okuziyizibwa n’amaanyi ne guva mu kkubo lyagwo erya bulijjo, bwe gusanga we guyita, ne gubuna n’amaanyi amangi era mu bungi.

Weewaawo, emirundi mingi tuziyiza omugga guno olw’omuwendo omutono gwe tugussaako. Naye ka tuleme kuguziyiza nate; ka twekebere munda tumenye olukomera olwo oluguziyiza. Ka tuggulirewo ekisa ekkubo; ka tununule ekiseera ekyabula, kubanga mpozzi tusigazza kitono. Okufa kutugoberera kumpi; ka tukwetegekere bulungi: kubanga tufa omulundi gumu gwokka; era okusobya awo tekuyinza kutereezebwa.

Nziramu nate, ka twekebere munda. Ekiseera kiyanguwa, tewali bbanga lya kulwawo: emmeeme zaffe ziri mu katyabaga. Nzikiriza nti oteeseteese bulungi bw’otyo nti tojja kugwibwako kibwatukira. Nkusiima olw’ekyo; kye kintu ekimu ekyetaagisa. Naye tuteekwa bulijjo okukikolerera, kubanga obutakulaakulana mu bulamu obw’omwoyo kwe kudda emabega. Naye abo abalina empewo ya Mwoyo Omutukuvu bagenda mu maaso ne mu tulo. Bwe kiba nti eryato ly’emmeeme yaffe likyasuukundibwa empewo n’omuyaga, ka tuzuukuse Mukama, eyeebase omwo, era ajja kukkakkanya mangu ennyanja.

Nneewadde eddembe okukubuulira endowooza zino ennungi, olyoke ozigeraageranye n’ezizo. Zijja kuyamba nate okuzikoleeza n’okuzaakiza, singa olw’omukisa omubi (Katonda akiziyize, kubanga mazima ddala gwandibadde mukisa mubi nnyo) zandibadde, ne bwe kiba kitono kitya, zinnyogoze. Kale ka ffembi tujjukire obunyiikivu bwaffe obwasooka. Ka tuganyulwe mu kyokulabirako ne mu ndowooza z’ow’oluganda ono, atamanyiddwa nnyo nsi, naye amanyiddwa Katonda, era Katonda gw’ayagala ennyo era gw’akuza ennyo. Nja kukusabira; naawe nsabira n’obunyiikivu, nze, mu Mukama waffe,

Owuwo, n’ebirala.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Ey’okutaano
fields.body_html:
Leero nfunye ebitabo bibiri n’ebbaluwa okuva eri Mwannyinaffe ——, eyeetegekera okwewaayo mu birayiro bye, era olw’ensonga eyo yeegayirira essaala z’ekibiina kyammwe ekitukuvu, n’ezizo naddala. Ndaba nga azesiga nnyo; nkwegayiridde tomuggwamu. Saba Katonda amusobozese okuwaayo ssaddaaka ye ng’atunuulira okwagala kwe kwokka, era n’okumalirira okunywevu okwewaayo ddala gy’ali. Nja kukuweereza ekimu ku bitabo bino ebyogera ku kubeerawo kwa Katonda; ensonga, mu ndowooza yange, erimu obulamu bwonna obw’omwoyo; era kirabika gye ndi nti buli agikola nga bw’esaanidde ajja kufuuka mangu ow’omwoyo.

Mmanyi nti okugikola obulungi, omutima gulina okuba nga mwereere ku bintu ebirala byonna; kubanga Katonda ayagala okugubeeramu yekka; era nga bw’atasobola kugubeeramu yekka nga tagwerezezzaamu birala byonna, bw’atyo tasobola kukolera omwo, n’akolamu ky’ayagala, okuggyako nga gumulekeddwa nga gwereere.

Mu nsi temuli bulamu bwa ngeri ndala businga buwoomi n’essanyu okusinga obulamu obw’okwogera ne Katonda obutayosa. Abo bokka abakikola era abakimanyi be basobola okukitegeera; naye sikuwa magezi kukikola olw’ensonga eyo. Si ssanyu lye tusaanidde okunoonya mu kwegezaamu kuno; wabula ka tukikole olw’okwagala, era kubanga Katonda ayagala tukikole.

Singa nnali mubuulizi, nandibuulidde, okusinga ebintu ebirala byonna, okwemanyiiza okubeerawo kwa Katonda; era singa nnali muluŋŋamya wa mwoyo, nandiwadde ensi yonna amagezi okukikola, kubanga nkitwala nga kyetaagisa nnyo, era nga kyangu nnyo.

Ai! singa twali tumanyi obwetaavu bwe tulina obw’ekisa n’obuyambi bwa Katonda, tetwandimuggyeeko maaso, nedda, wadde akaseera akamu. Nzikiriza; malirira kaakano ddala okumalirira okutukuvu era okunywevu obutaddayo kumwerabira mu bugenderevu, n’okumala ennaku zo ezisigaddeyo mu kubeerawo kwe okutukuvu, nga weefiiriza olw’okumwagala, bw’alaba nga kisaanidde, okubudaabudibwa kwonna.

Weemalire ku mulimu guno n’omutima gwonna, era bw’onoogukola nga bw’osaanidde, kakasa nti ojja kulaba mangu by’ogivaamu. Nja kukuyamba n’essaala zange, newaakubadde nga za kinaku. Neewaayo nnyo eri ezizo n’ez’ekibiina kyammwe ekitukuvu, nga ndi wuwe, era naddala

Owuwo, n’ebirala.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Ey’omukaaga
fields.body_html:
Eri oyo yennyini.

Nfunye okuva eri Mukyala ——, ebintu bye wamuwa okundeetera. Nneewuunya nti tonnambuulira ky’olowooza ku katabo ke nnakuweereza, k’olina okuba ng’ofunye. Nkwegayiridde weemalire n’omutima gwonna ku kukakolerako mu bukadde bwo: kirungi okukikola nga kikeereye okusinga obutakikola n’akatono.

Sisobola kulowooza ngeri abantu abeewaayo eri Katonda mu bulamu bw’abamonaki gye bayinza okubeera abamativu nga tebeemanyiiza kubeerawo kwa Katonda. Nze ku lwange, neekuumira naye mu kyama munda ddala oba mu makkati g’emmeeme yange nga bwe nsobola; era nga ndi naye bwe ntyo sitya kintu kyonna, naye okumukyukako akatono ennyo tekugumiikirizika.

Okwegezaamu kuno tekukooya nnyo mubiri; naye kirungi okugufiiriza oluusi, weewaawo emirundi mingi, essanyu ettono lingi eritaliiko kabi era erikkirizibwa, kubanga Katonda tajja kukkiriza mmeeme eyagala okwewaayo ddala gy’ali okufuna essanyu eddala okuggyako mu Ye: ekyo kisukka n’okuba eky’amagezi.

Sigamba nti n’olwekyo tulina okwekaka n’amaanyi. Nedda, tulina okuweereza Katonda mu ddembe ettukuvu; tulina okukola emirimu gyaffe n’obwesigwa; awatali kutawaana wadde kweraliikirira, nga tukomyawo amagezi gaffe eri Katonda mpola, era mu mirembe, buli lwe tugasanga nga gawabye ne gamuvaako.

Naye kyetaagisa okussa obwesige bwaffe bwonna mu Katonda, ne tulekayo ebirala byonna bye tufaako, era n’engeri ezimu ez’okusinza, ne bwe ziba nga nnungi nnyo mu zokka, naye ng’ezo omuntu bw’atera okwemalirako awatali nsonga, kubanga okusinza okwo kkubo bukubo erituusa ku kigendererwa. Kale bwe tuba nga, olw’okwegezaamu kuno okw’okubeerawo kwa Katonda, tuli naye ye kigendererwa kyaffe, olwo tekiba na mugaso kuddayo ku makubo; naye tuyinza okugenda mu maaso naye mu nkolagana yaffe ey’okwagala, nga tunyiikira mu kubeerawo kwe okutukuvu, ekiseera ekimu nga tumutendereza, nga tumusinza oba nga tumwegomba; ekiseera ekirala nga twewaayo gy’ali oba nga tumwebaza; ne mu ngeri zonna omwoyo gwaffe ze guyinza okuyiiya.

Toggwaamu maanyi olw’obutayagala bw’oyinza okusanga mu kino okuva mu butonde bwo; olina okwewaliriza. Mu kusooka omuntu atera okulowooza nti kufiirwa biseera, naye olina okugenda mu maaso, n’omalirira okunyiikira mu kyo okutuusa okufa, ne bwe wanaabaawo ebizibu byonna ebiyinza okujja. Neewaayo eri essaala z’ekibiina kyammwe ekitukuvu, n’ezizo naddala. Nze, mu Mukama waffe,

Owuwo, n’ebirala.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Ey’omusanvu
fields.body_html:
Nkusaasira nnyo. Kijja kuba kikulu nnyo bw’onoosobola okulekera —— okulabirira ensonga zo, n’omala obulamu bwo obusigaddeyo ng’osinza Katonda kyokka. Tatwetaagisa bintu binene; okumujjukira akatono buli kiseera; okumusinza akatono; oluusi okusaba ekisa kye, oluusi okumuwa okubonaabona kwo, n’oluusi okumwebaza olw’ebirungi by’akuwadde, era by’akyakuwa, wakati mu bizibu byo, n’okwebudaabuda naye emirundi emingi nga bw’osobola. Situla omutima gwo gy’ali, oluusi ne bw’oba ng’olya, era ne bw’oba ng’oli n’abantu: okumujjukira akatono ennyo kujja kumusanyusa bulijjo. Teweetaaga kukaaba waggulu nnyo; ali kumpi naffe okusinga bwe tumanyi.

Okubeera ne Katonda tekwetaagisa kubeera mu kkanisa bulijjo: tuyinza okufuula omutima gwaffe ekifo eky’okusabiramu, mwe twebbira buli kiseera okwogera naye mu bukkakkamu, mu bwetoowaze ne mu kwagala. Buli muntu asobola okwogera ne Katonda mu ngeri eno ey’oku lusegere, abamu okusinga, abalala kitono: amanyi kye tusobola okukola. Kale ka tutandike. Mpozzi asuubira kumalirira kumu kwokka okw’omutima omugabi ku ludda lwaffe. Guma omwoyo. Tusigazza kiseera kitono okubeera abalamu; oli kumpi kuweza emyaka nkaaga mu ena, nange kumpi kuweza kinaana. Ka tubeere abalamu era tufe ne Katonda. Okubonaabona kujja kutuwoomera era kutusanyusa nga tuli naye; n’essanyu erisinga obunene, awatali Ye, lijja kutubeerera ekibonerezo eky’ettima. Atenderezebwe olwa byonna. Amiina.

Kale weemanyiize, mpolampola, okumusinza bw’otyo, okusaba ekisa kye, okumuwa omutima gwo buli kiseera wakati mu mirimu gyo, ne buli kaseera, bw’oba osobola. Teweesibanga bulijjo mu bwegendereza obusukkiridde ku mateeka agamu, oba ku ngeri ez’enjawulo ez’okusinza, naye kola n’obwesige obw’awamu mu Katonda, n’okwagala n’obwetoowaze. Oyinza okukakasa —— nti mbasabira n’essaala zange ez’ekinaku, era nti ndi muweereza waabwe, era naddala

Owuwo mu Mukama waffe, n’ebirala.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Ey’omunaana
fields.body_html:
(Ku birowoozo ebiwaba mu Kusaba.)

Tombuulira kipya; si ggwe wekka atawaanyizibwa ebirowoozo ebiwaba. Amagezi gaffe gawaba nnyo ddala; naye, ng’okwagala kw’omutima bwe kufuga obusobozi bwaffe bwonna, kulina okubukomyawo, ne kubutwala eri Katonda ng’ekigendererwa kyabwo eky’enkomerero.

Amagezi bwe gaba, olw’obutafugibwa kimala mu kukuŋŋaanya ebirowoozo nga twakatandika okusinza, gafunye empisa embi ez’okuwaba n’okusaasaana, zizibu okuwangula, era zitera okutusika, ne bwe tuba nga tetwagala, okudda ku bintu eby’ensi.

Nzikiriza nti eddagala limu ku kino kwe kwatula ensobi zaffe, n’okwetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda. Sikuwa magezi kukozesa bigambo bingi mu kusaba: ebigambo ebingi n’okwogera okuwanvu emirundi mingi bye bireeta okuwaba. Weekuume mu kusaba mu maaso ga Katonda, ng’omusabiriza kasiru oba akoozimbye ku mulyango gw’omugagga. Gwe obeere n’omulimu ogw’okukuuma amagezi go mu maaso ga Mukama. Bwe gawaba oluusi ne gamuvaako, tokyeraliikirira nnyo: okutawaana n’okweraliikirira bisinga kusaasaanya magezi okusinga okugakuŋŋaanya: okwagala kw’omutima kulina okugakomyawo mu mirembe. Bw’onoonyiikira mu ngeri eno, Katonda ajja kukusaasira.

Engeri emu ey’okukuŋŋaanya amagezi mu bwangu mu kiseera eky’okusaba, n’okugakuuma okusingawo mu mirembe, kwe kutagaleka kuwaba wala nnyo mu biseera ebirala: olina okugakuuma n’obwegendereza mu maaso ga Katonda; era bw’onoomanyiira okumulowoozaako emirundi mingi, ojja kusanga nga kyangu okukuuma amagezi go nga gateredde mu kiseera eky’okusaba, oba waakiri okugakomyawo okuva mu kuwaba kwago.

Nkubuulidde dda mu bujjuvu, mu bbaluwa zange ezaasooka, emigaso gye tuyinza okufuna mu kwemanyiiza kuno okw’okubeerawo kwa Katonda: ka tukwemalireko mu mazima, era tusabiraganenga.

Owuwo, n’ebirala.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Ey’omwenda
fields.body_html:
Ebbaluwa eno gye nzisizzaamu kye kiddamu ky’eyo gye nnafuna okuva eri ——; nkwegayiridde ogimutuusize. Andabikira nga ajjudde omutima omulungi, naye ayagala kugenda mangu okusinga ekisa. Omuntu tafuuka mutukuvu mu kaseera kamu. Mmukwasa ggwe: tusaanidde okuyambagana n’amagezi gaffe, n’okusingawo n’ebyokulabirako byaffe ebirungi. Ojja kunkolera ekisa bw’onoombuuliranga ebimufaako buli kiseera, oba ng’abugumidde nnyo era ng’awulira nnyo.

Bwe tutyo ka tulowoozenga emirundi mingi nti omulimu gwaffe gwokka mu bulamu buno kwe kusanyusa Katonda, era nti ebirala byonna bya busirusiru na butaliimu. Ggwe nange tumaze emyaka nga ana mu bulamu bw’eddiini (kwe kugamba, obulamu bw’abamonaki). Tugikozesezza mu kwagala n’okuweereza Katonda, eyatuyita olw’okusaasira kwe mu mbeera eno era olw’ekigendererwa ekyo kyennyini? Nzijula ensonyi n’okutabulwa bwe ndowooza ku luuyi olumu ku birungi ebinene Katonda by’ankoledde, era by’akyagenda mu maaso okunkolera obutakoma; ne ku luuyi olulala, ku ngeri embi gye mbikozesezza, n’okukulaakulana kwange okutono mu kkubo ly’obutuukirivu.

Okuva bw’akyatuwa, olw’okusaasira kwe, ekiseera ekitono, ka tutandike mu mazima: ka tununule ekiseera ekyabula: ka tukomewo n’obukakafu obujjuvu eri Kitaffe oyo ow’okusaasira, bulijjo eyeetegefu okutwaniriza n’okwagala. Ka twerekereze, ka twerekereze n’omutima omugabi, olw’okumwagala, byonna ebitali Ye; asaanira okusingawo awatali kkomo. Ka tumulowoozengako obutakoma. Ka tussenga obwesige bwaffe bwonna mu Ye. Sibuusabuusa nti tujja kulaba mangu by’ekivaamu mu kufuna ekisa kye mu bungi, ekyo kye tusobola okukola nakyo byonna, era awatali kyo tetusobola kukola kirala wabula okwonoona.

Tetusobola kuwona bulabe obungi mu bulamu awatali buyambi bwa Katonda obwennyini era obw’olubeerera: kale ka tubumusabe obutayosa. Tuyinza tutya okumusaba nga tetuli naye? Tuyinza tutya okubeera naye okuggyako nga tumulowoozaako emirundi mingi? Era tuyinza tutya okumulowoozaako emirundi mingi, okuggyako nga tuyita mu mpisa entukuvu gye tusaanidde okwezimbamu? Ojja kuŋŋamba nti bulijjo njogera kintu kimu. Kituufu, kubanga eno ye nkola esinga obulungi era esinga obwangu gye mmanyi; era nga bwe sikozesa ndala, mpa ensi yonna amagezi okugikozesa. Tulina okumanya nga tetunnaba kwagala. Okusobola okumanya Katonda, tulina okumulowoozaako emirundi mingi; era bwe tunaatuuka okumwagala, olwo tujja kumulowoozaako emirundi mingi, kubanga omutima gwaffe gujja kubeera awali obugagga bwaffe. Eno nsonga esaanira ddala okugifumiitirizaako.

Nze, Owuwo, n’ebirala.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Ey’ekkumi
fields.body_html:
Kinzibuwalidde nnyo okwewaliriza okuwandiikira Mwami ——, era nkikola kaakano kubanga ggwe ne Nnyabo —— mukinsabye. Nkwegayiridde wandiika endagiriro ogimuweereze. Nsanyuse nnyo olw’obwesige bw’olina mu Katonda: nsaba akwongere obwo bungi nnyo okusingawo. Tetuyinza kuba na bwesige businga bungi mu Mukwano omulungi era omwesigwa bw’atyo, atalituleka mu nsi eno wadde mu eyo egenda okujja.

Mwami —— bw’anaaganyulwa mu kufiirwa kw’afunye, n’assa obwesige bwe bwonna mu Katonda, Katonda ajja kumuwa mangu mukwano omulala, asinga amaanyi era ayagala okumuyamba okusingawo. Akyusa emitima nga bw’ayagala. Mpozzi Mwami —— yali yeesibye nnyo ku mukwano gwe gw’afiiriddwa. Tusaanidde okwagala mikwano gyaffe, naye nga tetutyoboola kwagala kwe tubanja Katonda, okulina okuba okusooka.

Nkwegayiridde jjukira kye nnakusemba, kwe kugamba, okulowooza ku Katonda emirundi mingi, emisana, ekiro, mu mirimu gyo, ne mu by’okwesanyusaamu byo. Bulijjo ali kumpi naawe era ali naawe: tomuleka yekka. Wandirowoozezza nti kya bugwagwa okuleka mukwano gwo yekka eyakukyalidde: kale lwaki Katonda alagajjalirwa? N’olwekyo tomwerabiranga, naye mulowoozengako emirundi mingi, musinzenga obutayosa, beeranga mulamu era ofiire naye; guno gwe mulimu ogw’ekitiibwa ogw’Omukristaayo. Mu bufunze, kino kye tweyama; bwe tuba nga tetukimanyi, tulina okukiyiga. Nja kufuba okukuyamba n’essaala zange, era nze, mu Mukama waffe, Owuwo, n’ebirala.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Ey’ekkumi n’Emu
fields.body_html:
Sisaba nti owonyezebwe obulumi bwo, naye nsaba Katonda n’obunyiikivu akuwe amaanyi n’obugumiikiriza okubugumira okumala ekiseera kyonna ky’ayagala. Weebudaabude naye oyo akusibye ku musaalaba. Ajja kukusumulula bw’anaalaba nga kisaanidde. Balina omukisa abo ababonaabona naye: weemanyiize okubonaabona mu ngeri eyo, era omunoonyeemu amaanyi okugumira obungi, n’okumala ebbanga, nga bw’alisalawo nti kyetaagisa gy’oli. Abantu b’ensi tebategeera mazima gano, era si kya kwewuunya, kubanga babonaabona nga bwe bali, so si ng’Abakristaayo. Obulwadde babutwala ng’obulumi eri omubiri, so si ng’ekirabo okuva eri Katonda; era nga babulaba mu ngeri eyo yokka, tebalina kye basangamu wabula ennaku n’okulumwa. Naye abo abatwala obulwadde ng’obuva mu mukono gwa Katonda, ng’ekiva mu kusaasira kwe, era ng’ekkubo ly’akozesa olw’obulokozi bwabwe—abo, emirundi mingi basangamu obuwoomi bungi n’okubudaabudibwa okuwulikika.

Nandyagadde okakase nti Katonda emirundi mingi (mu ngeri emu) ali kumpi naffe, era ali naffe mu ngeri ey’amaanyi okusingawo, mu bulwadde okusinga mu bulamu obulungi. Teweesiga Musawo mulala yenna; kubanga, nga bwe ndaba, okukuwonya akwekuumidde ye yennyini. Kale ssa obwesige bwo bwonna mu Ye, era ojja kulaba mangu by’ekivaamu mu kuwona kwo, kwe tutera okulwisa nga twesiga eddagala okusinga Katonda.

Eddagala lyonna ly’onookozesa, lijja kukola nga bw’akkiriza kyokka. Obulumi bwe buva eri Katonda, Ye yekka y’asobola okubuwonya. Emirundi mingi aweereza endwadde z’omubiri okuwonya ez’emmeeme. Weebudaabude n’Omusawo asinga byonna ow’emmeeme n’omubiri.

Matira n’embeera Katonda gy’akuteekamu: ne bw’olowooza nti ndi musanyufu kyenkana wa, nkukwatirwa obuggya. Obulumi n’okubonaabona byandibadde lusuku lwa Katonda gye ndi bwe nnandibonaabonye ne Katonda wange; n’essanyu erisinga obunene lyandibadde ggeyeena gye ndi singa nnalisanyukira awatali Ye. Okubudaabudibwa kwange kwonna kwandibadde kubonaabona akantu ku lulwe.

Nteekwa, mu kiseera kitono, okugenda eri Katonda. Ekimbudaabuda mu bulamu buno kwe kuba nti kaakano mmulaba mu kukkiriza; era mmulaba mu ngeri eyinza okundeetera okugamba oluusi nti, Sikyakkiriza, wabula ndaba. Mpulira okukkiriza kye kutuyigiriza, era mu bukakafu obwo ne mu kukozesa okukkiriza okwo, nja kubeera mulamu era nfe naye.

Kale beeranga bulijjo ne Katonda: kye kiwanirira kyokka era ekibudaabuda mu kubonaabona kwo. Nja kumwegayirira abeere naawe. Nkulamusizza.

Owuwo, n’ebirala.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Ey’ekkumi n’Ebbiri
fields.body_html:
Singa twali tumanyidde bulungi okwegezaamu okubeerawo kwa Katonda, endwadde zonna ez’omubiri zandikendedde nnyo olw’ekyo. Emirundi mingi Katonda akkiriza tubonaabone katono okulongoosa emmeeme zaffe n’okutuwaliriza okusigala naye.

Guma omwoyo: muwenga obulumi bwo obutayosa: musabe akuwe amaanyi okubugumira. Okusinga byonna, funa empisa ey’okwogera ne Katonda emirundi mingi, era omwerabire nga bw’osobola okusinga obutono. Musinze mu bunafu bwo, weewengayo gy’ali buli kiseera, era mu kubonaabona kwo okusingira ddala, mwegayirire n’obwetoowaze n’okwagala (ng’omwana eri kitaawe) akufuule ng’okwagala kwe okutukuvu bwe kuli. Nja kufuba okukuyamba n’essaala zange ez’ekinaku.

Katonda alina engeri nnyingi ez’okutusembeza gy’ali. Oluusi atwekweka, naye okukkiriza kwokka, okutalitulekerera mu kiseera eky’obwetaavu, kwe kusaanidde okutuwanirira, n’okuba omusingi gw’obwesige bwaffe, obulina okuba bwonna mu Katonda.

Simanyi Katonda bw’anankola. Bulijjo ndi musanyufu. Ensi yonna ebonaabona; nange, asaanira okubonerezebwa okusingira ddala, mpulira essanyu eritakoma era eddene ennyo ne kiba nti sisobola kulyefuga.

Nandisabye Katonda n’omutima gwonna ekitundu ku kubonaabona kwo, singa saali mmanyi bunafu bwange, obunene ennyo, ne kiba nti singa andeka nzekka akaseera akamu nandibadde omuntu asingira ddala obunaku mu balamu. Kyokka simanyi ngeri gy’ayinza kundekamu nzekka, kubanga okukkiriza kumpa obukakafu obw’amaanyi nga ebiwulirwa omubiri bwe biyinza okukola, nti tatwabulira okutuusa nga ffe tusoose okumwabulira. Ka tutye okumuleka. Ka tubeerenga naye bulijjo. Ka tubeere abalamu era tufe mu kubeerawo kwe. Nsabira, nga nange bwe nkusabira.

Nze, Owuwo, n’ebirala.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Ey’ekkumi n’Essatu
fields.body_html:
Eri oyo yennyini.

Ndumwa nnyo okukulaba ng’obonaabona ebbanga eddene bwe lityo. Ekimpa akaweewo era ekiwoomya bye mpulira olw’ennaku yo kwe kuba nti bwe bujulirwa bw’okwagala kwa Katonda gy’oli. Bitunuulire mu ngeri eyo era ojja kubigumira mu bwangu okusingawo. Mu mbeera yo, ndowooza nti wandirese eddagala ly’abantu, n’oteewaayo ddala eri okulabirira kwa Katonda: mpozzi alindirira okwewaayo okwo kwokka n’obwesige obutuukiridde mu Ye, alyoke akuwonye. Okuva bwe kiri nti, newaakubadde nga ofubye nnyo, eddagala okutuusa kati teririna kye likoze, n’obulwadde bwo bukyeyongera, tekijja kuba kukema Katonda okwewaayo mu mikono gye, n’osuubira byonna okuva gy’ali.

Nnakugamba mu bbaluwa yange ey’enkomerero nti oluusi akkiriza endwadde z’omubiri okuwonya obulwadde bw’emmeeme. Kale guma omwoyo: obwetaavu bufuule empisa ennungi. Saba Katonda, si kuwonyezebwa bulumi bwo, wabula amaanyi okugumira n’obumalirivu, olw’okumwagala, byonna by’anaasiima, era okumala ebbanga lyonna ly’anaasiima.

Essaala ng’ezo, mazima, zizitowa katono eri omubiri, naye Katonda azisiima nnyo, era ziwoomera abo abamwagala. Okwagala kuwoomya obulumi; era omuntu bw’ayagala Katonda, abonaabona ku lulwe n’essanyu n’obuvumu. Kola bw’otyo, nkwegayiridde: weebudaabude naye, Ye Musawo yekka ow’endwadde zaffe zonna. Ye Kitaawe w’abo ababonaabona, bulijjo mwetegefu okutuyamba. Atwagala nnyo awatali kkomo okusinga bwe tulowooza. Kale mwagale, era tonoonya kubudaabudibwa walala wonna. Nsuubira nti ojja kukufuna mangu. Weeraba. Nja kukuyamba n’essaala zange, newaakubadde nga za kinaku, era nja kubeeranga bulijjo, mu Mukama waffe, Owuwo, n’ebirala.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Ey’ekkumi n’Ennya
fields.body_html:
Eri oyo yennyini.

Nneebaza Mukama waffe olw’okukuwummuzaako katono, nga bwe wali oyagala. Emirundi mingi mbadde kumpi okufa, naye sibangako mumativu nnyo nga mu biseera ebyo. Bwe ntyo saasaba kuwummuzibwa, naye nnasaba amaanyi okubonaabona n’obuvumu, n’obwetoowaze n’okwagala. Ai, nga kiwooma okubonaabona ne Katonda! Okubonaabona ne bwe kuba kunene kutya, kusembeze n’okwagala. Lusuku lwa Katonda okubonaabona n’obeera naye; bwe kityo bwe tuba twagala okufuna emirembe egy’omu lusuku lwa Katonda mu bulamu buno, tulina okwemanyiiza okwogera naye mu ngeri ey’oku lusegere, ey’obwetoowaze era ey’okwagala. Tulina okuziyiza emyoyo gyaffe okuwaba ne gimuvaako mu mbeera yonna. Tulina okufuula omutima gwaffe yeekaalu ey’omwoyo, mwe tumusinzizanga obutakoma. Tulina okwekuuma obutayosa, tuleme kukola, wadde okwogera, wadde okulowooza ekintu kyonna ekiyinza okumunyiiza. Amagezi gaffe bwe gaba nga gemalidde ku Katonda bwe gatyo, okubonaabona kujja kujjula okufukibwako amafuta n’okubudaabudibwa.

Mmanyi nti okutuuka ku mbeera eno entandikwa nzibu nnyo, kubanga tulina okukola mu kukkiriza kwokka. Naye newaakubadde nga kizibu, tumanyi era nti tusobola okukola byonna n’ekisa kya Katonda, ky’atagaana n’akatono abo abakimusaba n’obunyiikivu. Konkona, nyiikira okukonkona, era nkukakasa nti ajja kukuggulirawo mu kiseera kye ekituufu, akuwe omulundi gumu ebyo by’alwisizza okumala emyaka mingi. Weeraba! Musabe ku lwange, nga nange bwe mmusaba ku lulwo. Nsuubira okumulaba mangu.

Nze, Owuwo, n’ebirala.

fields.title: Ebbaluwa Ey’ekkumi n’Ettaano
fields.body_html:
Eri oyo yennyini.

Katonda amanyi bulungi okusinga bonna kye twetaaga, era byonna by’akola bya bulungi bwaffe. Singa twali tumanyi bw’atwagala ennyo, bulijjo twandibadde beetegefu okufuna kyenkanyi, awatali kwawulamu, okuva mu Mukono gwe ebiwoomu n’ebikaawa: byonna ebiva gy’ali byandibadde bitusanyusa. Okubonaabona okusinga okulumya tekulabika nga tekugumiikirizika, okuggyako nga tukulaba mu ngeri enkyamu. Bwe tukulaba nga kugabibwa mukono gwa Katonda, bwe tumanya nti Kitaffe ow’okwagala y’atukkakkanya era y’atunakuwaza, okubonaabona kwaffe kujja kuggwaamu obukaawa bwakwo, era kufuuke n’ensonga ey’okubudaabudibwa.

Omulimu gwaffe gwonna gubeere okumanya Katonda: omuntu gy’akoma okumumanya, gy’akoma okwegomba okumumanya. Era nga okumanya bwe kutera okuba ekipimo ky’okwagala, okumanya kwaffe gye kunaakoma okuba okw’obuziba era okugazi, gye kunaakoma okuba okunene okwagala kwaffe: era singa okwagala kwaffe eri Katonda kwali kunene, twandimwagadde kyenkanyi mu bulumi ne mu ssanyu.

Ka tuleme kumatira na kwagala Katonda olw’ebirungi byokka ebiwulirwa, ne bwe biba bya waggulu bitya, by’atukoledde, oba by’ayinza okutukolera. Ebirungi ng’ebyo, ne bwe biba binene bitya, tebiyinza kutusembeza gy’ali nga okukkiriza bwe kukola mu kikolwa kimu ekyangu. Ka tumunoonyenga emirundi mingi mu kukkiriza. Ali munda mu ffe: tomunoonya walala. Bwe tuba nga mazima tumwagala Ye yekka, tetuba ba bugwagwa, era tetusaanira kunenyezebwa, bwe twemalira ku bintu ebitaliimu ebitamusanyusa era mpozzi ebimunyiiza? Kya kutya nti ebintu bino ebitaliimu lumu bijja kutusaasaanyiza nnyo.

Ka tutandike okwewaayo gy’ali mu mazima ddala. Ka tugobe mu mitima gyaffe ebirala byonna. Ayagala okugibeeramu yekka. Musabe ekisa kino. Bwe tunaakola kye tusobola ku ludda lwaffe, tujja kulaba mangu enkyukakyuka eyo gye twegomba nga ekoleddwa mu ffe. Sisobola kumwebaza ekimala olw’okuwummuzaako kw’akuwadde. Nsuubira, olw’okusaasira kwe, ekisa eky’okumulaba mu nnaku ntono.* Ka tusabiraganenga.

Nze, mu Mukama waffe, Owuwo, n’ebirala.

* Yagwa ku kitanda ennaku bbiri oluvannyuma, n’afa mu wiiki eyo yennyini.
